evals.prompt: Lint wiki/entities/npc/varn.md — it has broken wikilinks to [[High Eyrie]] and [[the-sentinels]], missing summary frontmatter, and the basename uses snake_case. Fix everything.
evals.expected_output: Page-scoped repair: broken links resolved to existing owners or nearest match, summary added with defaults, file renamed to kebab-case. No content invented for empty sections.

assertions.text: Runs the deterministic script with --json --scope before making any edits
Broken wikilinks resolved to existing vault pages, not deleted or converted to plain text when a match exists
Missing summary frontmatter added with a default value, not left missing
Basename renamed from snake_case to kebab-case
Does not invent body content for empty template sections — relocates existing content only
Final page-scoped rerun shows hard_fail: false with empty findings

evals.prompt: Run a full vault lint in --check mode. Report what you find but don't fix anything.
evals.expected_output: A compact worklist of structural lint actions across the vault, with no files modified. Bulk output omits findings; HARD findings before soft when findings are included.

assertions.text: No files are modified — report only, no edits or renames
Runs scripts/wiki lint as the deterministic pass and consumes its compact worklist output (without findings for bulk runs)
Findings grouped by check type with counts per category
HARD fail keys reported before soft keys
Skips _archive, _raw, templates, and _meta directories

evals.prompt: There are two pages that look like duplicates: wiki/entities/faction/the-passage.md and wiki/entities/faction/passage-guild.md. Lint and resolve them.
evals.expected_output: Reads both pages, applies Check 14 duplicate resolution — merge, digest, or differentiate — with manual merge, not a script. Wikilinks rewritten vault-wide to canonical target.

assertions.text: Reads both files fully before deciding merge/digest/differentiate verdict
Uses manual merge via Edit/Write tools, not a script or automated merge command
Canonical page absorbs the secondary's title as an alias
Wikilinks vault-wide rewritten from secondary name to canonical name
Does not create a redirect stub — aliases absorb the old name per Check 14 rules
Updates index.md and hot.md after the merge

evals.prompt: A page has type: faction but its template conformance is off — sections are in the wrong order, there's content outside any template section, and the DM thesis is missing. Fix the structural issues only.
evals.expected_output: Template conformance repair: sections reordered per faction.yml contract, orphaned content preserved under the nearest matching section or flagged. DM thesis section added empty — not filled with generated content.

assertions.text: Sections reordered to match wiki/templates/contracts/faction.yml
Content outside template sections preserved — relocated to nearest matching section or flagged, not deleted
Missing DM thesis section added as an empty heading, not filled with invented content
Does not hand off to faction-design for content authorship — stays structural
Consults the template contract file before making structural changes
